    Third-seeded
    Illinois defeated second-seeded Houston 65-55 on March 26, 2026, in the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16, advancing to the Elite Eight to face Iowa. David Mirkovic recorded a double-double (14 points, 10 rebounds) to lead the Fighting Illini, who overcame a slow start with a dominant second-half performance and stifling defense to break the game open. 
    Key Game Details (March 26, 2026) 
    • Result: Illinois 65, Houston 55.
    • Location: Toyota Center, Houston, TX.
    • Top Scorers: David Mirkovic (14 pts), Keaton Wagler (13 pts), Andrej Stojakovic (13 pts) for Illinois.
    • Key Run: Following a tie in the second half, Illinois used a 17-0 run to build a 44-26 lead, according to University of Illinois Athletics.
    • Defense: Writing Illini reports that Illinois held Houston to
      shooting.
    • Upcoming Matchup: Illinois faces #9 seed Iowa in the Elite Eight on Saturday. 
    Game Summary
    Despite playing close to their campus, the Houston Cougars struggled offensively, with KTVB noting it was their lowest point total of the season. The Illinois defense, paired with 10 points and 12 rebounds from Keaton Wagler, secured their 11th Elite Eight appearance in program history, as detailed in University of Illinois Athletics. Illinois dominated the glass with a 43-34 rebounding edge and maintained control for 86% of the game, say Sports Illustrated.
